metadata.title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 DFlash2 Mia dual-Spark profile
metadata.description: Immutable Controller-native binding to MiaAI-Lab 79f10b91: EXL3/TR3 TP2, DFlash2 K7 with rank-0 draft TP, FP8 sparse-MLA target KV, BF16 draft KV, 1M context, 0.87 unified-memory utilization, 2048-token prefill chunks, four sequences, CUDA graphs, prefix caching, multimodal serving, and accepted f1 dual rails. Upstream measured a 1,754,237-token / 18.67 GiB KV pool and requires at least 105.9 GiB free after approximately 9 GiB initialization; the recipe converts that receipt into a strict 126,000,000,000-byte Controller admission contract per node.

removal_condition: Remove only after stock vLLM supports the exact GLM 5.3 NoPE sparse-MLA, EXL3, DFlash2, hybrid-KV, reasoning, tool, and SM121 behavior and the two-Spark qualification is repeated.
